variant_decisions.evidence: ASV renders an imperative continuing the imperative of the first clause: "Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ." A future indicative (base ἀναπληρώσετε) would appear as "and so ye shall fulfil"; the bare "fulfil" coordinated with "Bear ye" answers to the aorist imperative ἀναπληρώσατε.

variant_decisions.evidence: This unit and the μὴ of v008 are the same negative in different positions relative to τῷ σταυρῷ; either arrangement yields "only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ." The ASV's only mapped note is an alternative_rendering for "for" and does not touch the negative.
ASV reads "the cross of Christ" with no "Jesus"; the added Ἰησοῦ of r01 would be represented in so literal a version, and no note records it.

The negative is present in both readings of the verse — retained here in the base, carried by the ἵνα μὴ of r01 at v006 — so the ASV's "that they may not be persecuted" is satisfied either way and does not fix its position.
